name: Ray-Octree Boundary Intersection
definition: Calculates the entry and exit distances of a ray relative to the bounding box of an octree root node. It normalizes the ray direction to be positive to simplify intersection logic and handles zero-direction components to prevent division by zero.
summary: Ray-Octree Boundary Intersection calculates ray entry and exit distances for an octree root node by normalizing direction to strictly positive values to simplify intersection logic.
